name: EPIC 210976630

text.card: A red giant 4,237 parsecs away, 29 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.70 solar masses and 28.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,412 K at its surface.
